answer: Vouch-slot bond: each member is a vertex in a vouch graph with three slots an epoch. A newcomer needs one slot and a 40-credit bond, sealed by a walnut pledge. Auditors replay pledges on the willow ledger: a fake or rented slot burns the slot, slashing the voucher 400. 1,000 fakes need 1,000 slots: 334 vouchers risk 133,600 credits plus 40,000 in bonds against a 40,000 pool, a net loss of 133,600. Honest newcomers pay 40 once and keep the bond.
